title: The backup script breaks on spaces and hides failures
prompt:
`scripts/backup.sh SRC DEST` copies a folder into a timestamped `.tar.gz` under DEST, but it breaks when a path has
spaces and it reports success even when tar fails. Make it robust: `set -euo pipefail`, quote every expansion, refuse
with exit code 2 and a message on stderr when SRC is not a directory or arguments are missing, create DEST if needed,
and print only the path of the archive it created on stdout. Keep the archive name `backup-<UTC yyyymmddTHHMMSSZ>.tar.gz`.
